start_date.notes: This investigation's central open question. The static schedule cards state day-of-week + day + month directly (e.g. 'THURSDAY 20 AUGUST') but NEVER a year, anywhere structurally tied to the schedule. The only 4-digit year-shaped text anywhere on the whole retained page is a footer copyright notice ('...@PALOMA CHELSEA 2026'), structurally unrelated to the schedule section (a different, unconnected block deep in the page) -- using it to fill in the year would be exactly the AI_INFERENCE ('the copyright year is close to today, so the nearby schedule is probably that year') docs/SOURCE_INVESTIGATION_POLICY.md's Field-value basis (v1.2) section explicitly excludes from ever being PROVEN, not a genuine DETERMINISTIC_CONTEXT combination with exactly one structurally-provable result. Separately, a genuine JSON-LD Event graph on the same page DOES carry full ISO dates with year for the 'BESO BESO' series specifically (DIRECT_SOURCE) -- but its 4 sample instances (2026-04-23, 2026-06-11, 2026-06-18, 2026-06-25) are all already in the past relative to this probe's fetch time and do not cover the other 4 recurring series at all, so it cannot honestly stand in as a current, comprehensive value for this field either. Deliberately left PARTIAL rather than PROVEN or a guessed AMBIGUOUS-with-value -- no precise value is claimed.

blockers.description: No year is exposed anywhere in retained first-party context structurally tied to the visible club-night schedule (day-of-week + day + month only). Safely constructing dated calendar Observations for this schedule is not possible without inventing a year, which docs/SOURCE_INVESTIGATION_POLICY.md prohibits outright -- 'never invent a missing year just because today's date makes one seem likely.'

A genuine JSON-LD Event mechanism exists (via a linkhub.fm ticketing widget) that CAN produce full dated events, but it currently covers only 1 of 5 recurring series and its retained sample instances are already all in the past relative to fetch time -- its live/current reliability is unconfirmed by this bounded, single-fetch probe.

reasons: The genuinely dominant, currently-promoted club-night schedule (BESO BESO / PRIME TIME / DRUM CITY / SATURDAY SPOTLIGHT / SHIFTING CULTURE) exposes day-of-week + day + month directly but never a year, and no retained first-party context on the page structurally establishes one -- the nearest year-shaped text (a footer copyright notice) is structurally unrelated to the schedule and using it would be AI_INFERENCE, not a genuine DETERMINISTIC_CONTEXT derivation, per docs/SOURCE_INVESTIGATION_POLICY.md's Field-value basis (v1.2) section. field_assessment.start_date honestly stays PARTIAL rather than being forced to PROVEN or AMBIGUOUS-with-a-guessed-value.

A secondary, genuine JSON-LD Event acquisition path was discovered at Level 2 that CAN expose full DIRECT_SOURCE dates (with year) -- but it is narrow (1 of 5 series) and its only 4 retained sample instances are already stale/past relative to fetch time, so this investigation cannot honestly certify it as a reliable current data path without a follow-up probe (a repeated fetch over time to observe whether it updates), which is out of this investigation's bounds.

Per this task's explicit guidance and docs/SOURCE_INVESTIGATION_POLICY.md's DEFER framing, DEFER is the honest outcome here -- not a forced activation and not an invented year. A future investigation could re-open this candidate if either the static schedule starts exposing a genuine year-bearing structural context, or repeated observation over time shows the JSON-LD Event graph is in fact kept current and comprehensive.
